Subject: RE: Meridian QBR kickoff + renewal hygiene

Ben / team,

I reviewed the workbook and Meridian's activity. Proposed risk categorization (draft):
- Risk: Medium-High
  - Drivers: spike in inference errors (support tickets 12 in last 30d), token spend growth + poor batching on new pilot, audit-log retention gap (customer expects 18 months; default retention is 90 days).
- Recommended Exec Asks (for the one-pager):
  1) Approve a limited credit pool (up to $45k) to smooth token-cost delta while we optimize batching/configs.
  2) Fast-track a technical deep-dive (SRE + model ops) next week to remediate errors; request SLA exception for priority triage.
  3) Commit to an extended retention pilot (6 months) while we scope a hardened audit/log export for their compliance team.

Please see the heatmap tab in the workbook for signal weights. I can convert these into the slide one-pager once we agree on the asks.

- Lauren

Date: 2028-01-15T11:22:00Z
Subject: RE: Meridian QBR kickoff + renewal hygiene

Folks,

Quick OKR/ops perspective ahead of the sync: our Q1 SRE capacity is tight (two infra hires onboarding), but we can commit a 6-hour focused troubleshooting slot next Tue (2028-01-24) with model ops to investigate the inference error spike. Preliminary root-cause hypothesis: the new pilot is using longer context windows causing KV cache miss patterns and exacerbating a rare kernel fallback path on the GPU runtime.

Mitigation options (short list):
- Short term (1-2 weeks): increase per-request batching threshold and enable prefix KV caching for the pilot. This reduces token egress by ~12% in similar customers.
- Mid term (2-6 weeks): push a targeted kernel patch to reduce fallback incidence (requires a small QA window).
- Commercial: if we approve a $30k credit to offset elevated token spend while the cache changes roll out, we can keep the pilot stable and avoid procurement escalation.

I'll prepare a short tech note to include in the one-pager. Also tagging Aditya to confirm if finance can fast-track a $30k contra within the proposed time window.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
